sources.name: APR — Registar finansijskih izveštaja (financial statements register)
sources.verdict: Parent APR portal verified live and lists the financial-statements register; this unified search URL is the known public entry point but was not individually fetched this session. Annual statements downloadable per entity at no cost.

sources.name: APR — Registar založnog prava (pledge register)
sources.verdict: Register confirmed on the verified APR registers index (zalozno pravo); deep URL not individually fetched. Key for private-credit/ABL collateral mapping.

sources.name: APR — Registar finansijskog lizinga (financial leasing contracts register)
sources.verdict: Register confirmed on the verified APR registers index; deep URL not individually fetched. Contract-level leasing data complements the NBS lessor register.

sources.name: APR — Registar faktoringa (factoring register)
sources.verdict: Register confirmed on the verified APR registers index; deep URL not individually fetched. Maps trade/supply-chain finance players.

sources.name: Portal otvorenih podataka Republike Srbije (data.gov.rs)

sources.name: Komisija za hartije od vrednosti (Serbian SEC) — registers of licensed entities
sources.verdict: Verified live (Aug 2026). Publishes registers of investment firms, fund management companies (drustva za upravljanje), UCITS AND alternative investment funds (AIF), brokers, portfolio managers, custodian banks, plus a register of digital-token service providers under the Law on Digital Assets. Core AIFM universe for Serbia.

sources.name: Narodna banka Srbije — Spisak banaka (bank register)
sources.verdict: Verified live; NBS financial-institutions section confirmed publishing the bank list plus balance-sheet data per bank.

sources.name: NBS — insurance undertakings register and market data
sources.verdict: Insurance market participants list and business-operation data confirmed via the verified NBS financial-institutions section; deep URL not individually fetched. NBS is the insurance regulator (LP side).

sources.name: NBS — voluntary pension fund management companies + FONDex
sources.verdict: Confirmed via verified NBS section: register of voluntary pension fund ManCos and FONDex unit values. The domestic institutional-LP universe; deep URL not individually fetched.

sources.name: NBS — financial leasing providers register
sources.verdict: Lessors list and business data confirmed via verified NBS section; deep URL not individually fetched.

sources.name: NBS — payment institutions and e-money institutions registers
sources.verdict: Both registers confirmed via verified NBS section (plus third-country e-money list); deep URL not individually fetched.

sources.name: NBS — virtual currency service providers (Law on Digital Assets)
sources.verdict: NBS supervises virtual-currency VASPs (SEC supervises digital tokens) under Serbia's Law on Digital Assets — MiCA does not apply (non-EU). Digital-asset supervision referenced on the verified NBS site; this specific register URL not fetch-verified.

sources.name: NBS — prinudna naplata (blocked/forced-collection accounts search)
sources.verdict: Well-known NBS public search of companies with blocked accounts — the standard Serbian distress signal used by every local credit-data provider. Not fetch-verified this session; NBS root verified live.

sources.name: Ministarstvo finansija — register of licensed real-estate appraisers (procenitelji)
sources.verdict: MFIN site verified live and lists 'Procenitelji vrednosti nepokretnosti' as a service (licensing under the Law on Valuers); the actual register page was not reached. Valuer roll for real-assets service graph.

sources.name: Sluzbeni glasnik Republike Srbije (Official Gazette)
sources.verdict: slglasnik.rs verified redirecting (302) to slglasnik.com, which failed our fetcher's TLS check (unable to verify certificate). Gazette publisher exists and operates; treat as verified-with-TLS-caveat. Full-text access largely via the legal information system below.

sources.name: ALSU — Agencija za licenciranje stecajnih upravnika (insolvency supervision)
sources.verdict: Verified live (news to Jul 2026). Directory of licensed insolvency practitioners, bankruptcy case database (debtor, court, practitioner, dates), estate asset-sale announcements, quarterly reports. This is the platform's deep prior integration — extend only, one source among many.

sources.name: APR — Registar stecajnih masa i sudskih zabrana (bankruptcy estates, court restrictions)
sources.verdict: Bankruptcy-estate and court-restriction registers confirmed on the verified APR registers index; deep URL not individually fetched. Complements ALSU case data.

sources.name: Beogradska berza (BELEX — Belgrade Stock Exchange)

sources.name: Centralni registar, depo i kliring hartija od vrednosti (CSD)

sources.name: Portal javnih nabavki (public procurement portal)

sources.name: Kancelarija za javne nabavke (Public Procurement Office)

sources.name: Razvojna agencija Srbije (RAS — Development Agency of Serbia)

sources.name: Fond za inovacionu delatnost (Innovation Fund + Serbia Ventures)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Publishes public-call results and awardee lists (924 supported projects, EUR 125m). Serbia Ventures / Serbia Ventures AI is the state LP program seeding domestic VC funds — a direct register-grade route into the Serbian GP/LP graph.

sources.name: Fond za razvoj Republike Srbije (Development Fund)
sources.verdict: Verified live (gov.rs domain 301-redirects here). State lender: credit lines, restructuring, sector programs. Public-credit side of the ecosystem.

sources.name: Udruzenje banaka Srbije (Association of Serbian Banks)

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin on Serbia: a handful of regional GPs/funds that touch Serbia (SEE/CEE buyout and infra vehicles) and DFI LPs; essentially no coverage of local service graph, NPL market, or sub-institutional managers. Serbia usually appears only inside CEE aggregates.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Fund manager self-reporting plus public filings and DFI disclosures. Direct-route equivalents for us: EBRD/IFC project disclosures, Serbian SEC (KHOV) fund and ManCo registers, Invest Europe CEE activity reports.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Covers headline Serbian VC/PE deals (Nordeus/Take-Two, Tenderly, Ominimo) and M&A with named advisors, but long-tail and local mid-market deals are patchy; financials often absent because they don't mine APR.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, startup media, law-firm deal announcements. Direct routes for us: The Recursive/Netokracija/Startit RSS, eKapija deal reporting, APR financial statements for the actual numbers.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best-in-class Serbian startup mapping via co-branded ecosystem reports with local partners (Digital Serbia Initiative orbit); strong on startups/rounds, weak on PE, credit, real assets and the institutional layer.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Ecosystem partners (DSI), accelerator/awardee lists, startup media. Direct routes: DSI member/eco data, Innovation Fund public-call results (incl. Serbia Ventures backed funds), Netokracija/Startit feeds.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow self-reported Serbian company profiles; funding data inconsistent, no registry grounding, no distressed/credit dimension.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Self-reporting and news scraping. Direct routes: same news feeds plus APR as the corrective registry spine we have and they lack.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Local company-credit data for RS + region: 128k companies, financials, blocked accounts, court/insolvency data, ownership links, tax debt. Strong deterministic base, zero alternatives-specific intelligence (no fund/GP/LP layer, no signals).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Visibly: APR company register + financial statements, NBS blocked-accounts (prinudna naplata), court/insolvency registers, tax-debtor lists. All of these are public and cataloged above for direct ingestion.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Serbian credit-scoring and company-monitoring platform used by banks/corporates; APR-grounded financials and distress flags. Site refused our connection this session (ECONNREFUSED) — existence known, not re-verified. No alternatives layer.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: APR financial statements and status changes, NBS forced-collection register, ALSU/court insolvency data — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Both a news source and a paid company-data/tender-intelligence provider; strongest local deal/tender/real-estate signal coverage in Serbian. Bot-blocked to our fetcher (403).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own journalism plus APR data and the public procurement portal. We ingest headlines/links per copyright discipline and go directly to APR + jnportal for the underlying data; never scrape their paid database.

searchedButAbsent: Constraints first: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so everything above was verified by direct fetch of known URLs; items I could not confirm by fetch are marked honestly. Absent or not-found: (1) National PE/VC association — no active Serbian Private Equity Association (SPEA-style) site could be confirmed; Serbia has no Invest Europe-affiliated national association; the gap is filled by SEC AIF/ManCo registers, Innovation Fund's Serbia Ventures program, DSI, and regional sources (Invest Europe CEE report, Vestbee). (2) EU ETS carbon registry national accounts — Serbia is not in the EU ETS; no national allowance registry exists (only future CBAM alignment); carbon category is genuinely absent. (3) MiCA licensee register — MiCA does not apply; the domestic Law on Digital Assets regime splits registers between NBS (virtual currencies) and SEC (digital tokens), both cataloged. (4) Standalone fund-administrator licensee list — none; depositary/custodian licensing sits inside the SEC registers. (5) UBO register — APR keeps Central Records of Beneficial Owners but public access is restricted (per project rule: never assume open UBO). (6) RICS Serbia — no national RICS directory; valuer roll is the MFIN licensed-appraiser register plus the national valuers association (NUPS), whose site I could not verify without search. (7) Leasing association (ALCS) — could not verify an active site; NBS lessor register covers the universe. (8) Unreachable during session despite likely existing: priv.rs (DNS dead — privatization moved under Ministry of Economy), boniteti.rs (connection refused), belex.rs / rgz.gov.rs / privreda.gov.rs / uos.rs / slglasnik.com (TLS certificate failures at our fetcher — several Serbian state sites use certificate chains our fetcher rejects; production crawler should retry with a proper trust store). (9) Beta news agency (beta.rs) — subscription wire, not verified, excluded rather than padded.
